newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FALL LED BY $14 MOGAS PLUNGE.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS FALL LED BY $14 MOGAS PLUNGE.

text.p: NWE oil products and refinery margins slumped on Friday morning as gasoline plunged $14 a tonne.
A premium unleaded gasoline barge traded at $216 fob ARA after trade either side of $230 on Thursday. Some dealers expected further losses next week.
An August swaps was heard traded at $211 having traded at $213 on Thursday.
Naphtha lost about $3 a tonne to talk $193.50 for August while gas oil lost $1.50 on the IPE.
Heavy fuel was little changed at $94 to 495.
